按条目检索读取，不整篇加载。

## 特效-压纹玻璃-粉彩与冰蓝

逻辑路径：assets/模板库/特效/特效-压纹玻璃-粉彩与冰蓝.html

````html
<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>特效-压纹玻璃-粉彩与冰蓝</title><meta name="standalone-template" content="1"><style data-standalone-base>html,body{margin:0;padding:0}</style><style data-compiled-dependencies>.vl-image-fade { mask-image:linear-gradient(var(--vl-fade-angle,180deg),var(--vl-fade-stops,#000 0%,#000 100%)); mask-mode:alpha; mask-repeat:no-repeat; mask-size:100% 100%; }

.vl-light-field { position:relative; isolation:isolate; }
.vl-light-field__glow { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; pointer-events:none; border-radius:inherit; opacity:var(--vl-glow-opacity,.22); background:radial-gradient(ellipse var(--vl-glow-width,75%) var(--vl-glow-height,55%) at var(--vl-glow-x,25%) var(--vl-glow-y,20%),var(--vl-glow-color,var(--vl-accent,#e7a4bd)) var(--vl-glow-core,0%),transparent 100%); }

.vl-soft-scene { position:relative; isolation:isolate; overflow:hidden; }
.vl-soft-scene__decor { position:absolute; inset:var(--vl-soft-inset,0); z-index:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:var(--vl-soft-opacity,1); filter:blur(var(--vl-soft-blur,0px)); }
.vl-soft-scene__decor > img { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }
.vl-soft-scene__mist { position:absolute; inset:var(--vl-mist-inset,0); z-index:1; pointer-events:none; opacity:var(--vl-mist-opacity,0); background:var(--vl-mist-paint,none); }
.vl-soft-scene__subject { position:relative; z-index:2; }
.vl-soft-scene__content { position:relative; z-index:3; }

.vl-glass {
  --vl-shadow: 0;
  --vl-alpha: .24;
  --vl-blur: 18px;
  --vl-grain: .18;
  --vl-edge: .95;
  --vl-highlight: .40;
  --vl-texture-size: 176px;
  --vl-texture: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");
}

.vl-pebble { position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pebble-base,#f4f5ef); }
.vl-pebble__color { position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--pebble-field,radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 24%,#efb4d1 0%,transparent 43%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 16% 65%,#acd0cc 0%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,#faf7ec,#c6ddea)); }
.vl-pebble__relief { position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:var(--pebble-relief,.58);mix-blend-mode:soft-light;pointer-events:none; }
.vl-pebble__copy { position:relative;z-index:1;padding:32px;color:#24353b; }
.vl-pebble--ice { --pebble-field:radial-gradient(ellipse at 8% 74%,#f2f2e8 0%,transparent 43%),linear-gradient(126deg,#d9e4e7 0%,#92bcdc 36%,#b8d2e5 55%,#efeee7 84%);--pebble-relief:.7; }
</style></head><body><div class="vl-pebble" style="min-height:300px">
 <div class="vl-pebble__color" aria-hidden="true"></div>
 <svg class="vl-pebble__relief" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs><filter id="pebble-a" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">
   <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".16 .20" numOctaves="2" seed="23" result="height"/>
   <feDiffuseLighting in="height" surfaceScale="2.5" diffuseConstant="1" lighting-color="white" result="diff"><feDistantLight azimuth="225" elevation="42"/></feDiffuseLighting>
   <feSpecularLighting in="height" surfaceScale="3" specularConstant=".65" specularExponent="12" lighting-color="white" result="shine"><feDistantLight azimuth="225" elevation="55"/></feSpecularLighting>
   <feBlend in="diff" in2="shine" mode="screen"/>
  </filter></defs>
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white" filter="url(#pebble-a)"/>
 </svg>
 <div class="vl-pebble__copy">独立的清晰文字</div>
</div>
</body></html>
````

## 特效-套色网印与错版颗粒

````html
<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>特效-套色网印与错版颗粒</title><meta name="standalone-template" content="1"><style data-standalone-base>html,body{margin:0;padding:0}</style><style data-compiled-dependencies>.vl-dot-pattern { background-image:radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb,var(--vl-dot-color,#e5ffff) calc(var(--vl-dot-alpha,1) * 100%),transparent) var(--vl-dot-radius,1.4px),transparent calc(var(--vl-dot-radius,1.4px) + .3px)); background-size:var(--vl-dot-step,5px) var(--vl-dot-step,5px); }

.vl-riso__copy { position:relative;z-index:1;padding:32px; }
.vl-riso__yellow { fill:var(--riso-yellow,#ced12c); }
.vl-riso__blue { fill:var(--riso-blue,#4282aa); }
.vl-riso__red { fill:var(--riso-red,#d65b45); }
</style></head><body><div class="vl-riso" style="min-height:300px">
 <svg class="vl-riso__ink" viewBox="0 0 600 400" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true">
  <defs>
   <filter id="riso-a-rough" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".45" numOctaves="2" seed="18" result="n"/><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="2.2" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G"/></filter>
   <pattern id="riso-a-y" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(23)"><ellipse class="vl-riso__yellow" cx="3" cy="3" rx="2.2" ry="1.6"/></pattern>
   <pattern id="riso-a-b" width="6.5" height="6.5" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(-17)"><ellipse class="vl-riso__blue" cx="3" cy="3" rx="1.6" ry="1.25"/></pattern>
  </defs>
  <g filter="url(#riso-a-rough)"><path d="M0 0H380Q220 150 360 400H0Z" fill="url(#riso-a-y)"/><path d="M310 0H600V400H120Q420 180 310 0" fill="url(#riso-a-b)" style="mix-blend-mode:multiply" transform="translate(2 -1)"/></g>
 </svg>
 <div class="vl-riso__copy">独立排版的内容</div>
</div>
</body></html>
````

````html
<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>特效-局部掉墨与擦损</title><meta name="standalone-template" content="1"><style data-standalone-base>html,body{margin:0;padding:0}</style><style data-compiled-dependencies>.vl-r3-wear-demo{--vl-r3-ground:#242420;--vl-r3-warning:#d7dd16;--vl-r3-ink:#292a21;--vl-r3-paper:#c6c2aa;--vl-r3-muted:#999781;max-width:658px;padding:24px;background:var(--vl-r3-paper);font-family:RetroSource,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box}.vl-r3-wear{--vl-r3-wear-strength:.23;--vl-r3-wear-color:var(--vl-r3-paper,#c6c2aa);position:relative;isolation:isolate}.vl-r3-wear__marks{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;opacity:var(--vl-r3-wear-strength);background:radial-gradient(ellipse 22px 3px at 8% 17%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 0 68%,transparent 74%),radial-gradient(ellipse 3px 11px at 17% 87%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 0 66%,transparent 74%),radial-gradient(ellipse 37px 2px at 58% 9%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 0 65%,transparent 75%),radial-gradient(ellipse 11px 4px at 87% 71%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 0 65%,transparent 76%),radial-gradient(ellipse 31px 2px at 73% 93%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 0 65%,transparent 75%)}.vl-r3-wear__marks:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(116deg,transparent 0 12%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 12.1% 12.3%,transparent 12.4% 66%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 66.1% 66.25%,transparent 66.4%),linear-gradient(7deg,transparent 0 83%,var(--vl-r3-wear-color) 83.1% 83.35%,transparent 83.5%);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 23%,75% 18%,72% 78%,100% 80%,100% 100%,0 100%,0 69%,22% 72%,24% 27%,0 25%)}.vl-r3-wear__content{position:relative;z-index:2}.vl-r3-wear-demo__panel{padding:26px;background:var(--vl-r3-ink);color:var(--vl-r3-paper)}.vl-r3-wear-demo__title{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:clamp(22px,5vw,34px);font-weight:700}.vl-r3-wear-demo__copy{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;font-weight:400}
.vl-r3-wear__marks{background:var(--vl-r3-wear-color);mask-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");mask-size:320px 210px;mask-repeat:repeat;opacity:var(--vl-r3-wear-strength,.6)}.vl-r3-wear__marks:before{display:none}.vl-r3-wear{--vl-r3-wear-strength:.6}
</style></head><body><div class="vl-r3-wear-demo"><section class="vl-r3-wear vl-r3-wear-demo__panel"><span class="vl-r3-wear__marks" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="vl-r3-wear__content"><h2 class="vl-r3-wear-demo__title">已归档 / FILED</h2><p class="vl-r3-wear-demo__copy">墨面边缘留下细小擦痕，档案正文仍保持完整、清晰。此装饰层可用于深墨事实栏，也可叠在警戒带上。</p></div></section></div>
</body></html>
````

````html
<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>特效-织物手作</title><meta name="standalone-template" content="1"><style data-standalone-base>html,body{margin:0;padding:0}</style><style data-compiled-dependencies>.vl-weave { position:relative; isolation:isolate; }
.vl-weave__texture { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; pointer-events:none; border-radius:inherit; opacity:var(--vl-weave-opacity,.12); background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,var(--vl-weave-light,#f2d4a0) 0 var(--vl-weave-line,.65px),transparent var(--vl-weave-line,.65px) var(--vl-weave-step,5px)),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--vl-weave-dark,#4c281b) 0 var(--vl-weave-line,.65px),transparent var(--vl-weave-line,.65px) var(--vl-weave-step,5px)); }
</style></head><body><section class="vl-weave" style="background:var(--vl-tint)"><span class="vl-weave__texture" aria-hidden="true"></span><h2>织纹章节</h2></section>
````
